Class ColumnStatistics

Namespace
ParquetNeo.Statistics

ParquetNeo.dll

The statistics of one column chunk, decoded to .NET values. Obtain it from GetStatistics(int).

public sealed record ColumnStatistics : IEquatable<ColumnStatistics>

Remarks

Min and Max are physical values: bool, int, long, float, double or byte[] (BYTE_ARRAY and FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY), the same types the column is read as. They are ordered the way the column's type defines, which is not always the order of the .NET type: unsigned integer columns (UINT_8 to UINT_64) are stored in int and long but compare unsigned; strings and binary compare as unsigned bytes; decimals as big-endian two's complement numbers.

They are bounds and may not be values in the column: when IsMinExact or IsMaxExact is not true, the bound may be shortened or rounded. A value is null when it was not recorded or cannot be trusted (for example the column order is unknown, or a floating-point bound is NaN).

Parameters

Min object

A lower bound of the non-null, non-NaN values.

Max object

An upper bound of the non-null, non-NaN values.

NullCount long?

How many rows are null.

NanCount long?

How many values are NaN (floating-point columns only). When absent, NaNs may be present.

IsMinExact bool?

Whether Min is the actual minimum; null if the writer did not say.

IsMaxExact bool?

Whether Max is the actual maximum; null if the writer did not say.
